page.layout: One text column with a running head above it and a catchword and signature at the foot. The running head and page number are at the top. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: Legem illam sic ampliatam: ita interim ut
liberatio, vita, libertas, & salus illis nihilo-
bonorum suo modo & gradu in hac vita
etiam fierent participes. Sic ad consola-
sanguinis Testamenti veri, ex quo vera hæ-

page.notes: The page is a single text column. The bottom left "Q" is a gathering signature and "Unde" at the foot right is the catchword. The digitiser credit at the lower right was left out. Some words in the first line of the running head and the old-style page number are slightly blurred but readable.
